name: @aaryanbindage/omnicontext
description: Persistent, cross-device memory for Claude: your profile, your projects, and resumable handoffs.
long_description: OmniContext gives every Claude session the same long-term memory: who you are, what you're working on, and where you left off. Refer to "my game project" and Claude knows which one you mean. Save a handoff on one device and resume it on another. Data is plain files in ~/.omnicontext, synced through a private git repo you own.

tools.name: remember
tools.description: Save a durable fact about the user

tools.name: resolve_project
tools.description: Resolve "my game project" to a project

tools.name: add_project_note
tools.description: Add a note to a project

tools.name: save_handoff
tools.description: Save work to resume on any device

prompts.name: resume
prompts.description: Continue the most recent open handoff
prompts.text: Call resume_handoff and continue that work.

prompts.name: handoff
prompts.description: Save the current work as a handoff
prompts.text: Summarise the current work and call save_handoff.
